text: {"question": "How many adult patients with high-frequency episodic migraine or chronic migraine were included in the multicenter retrospective observational study in Romania?", "answer": "The study included a total of 113 adult patients, consisting of 38 with high-frequency episodic migraine and 75 with chronic migraine.", "evidence": "We conducted a multicenter retrospective observational cohort study including 113 adults with HFEM (n = 38) or CM (n = 75) who initiated treatment with galcanezumab, erenumab, fremanezumab, or eptinezumab at specialized headache centers in Romania."}
